user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot

user_agents.scope: ChatGPT search indexing and robots.txt fetching.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow OAI-SearchBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety and relevance of landing pages submitted as ChatGPT ads.
user_agents.scope: Only visits landing pages submitted as ads; not used for training.

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl content to train generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for OpenAI generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow GPTBot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Perform actions triggered by user requests in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs.
user_agents.scope: User-initiated web visits and interactions via GPT Actions.
user_agents.opt_out: Robots.txt rules may not apply to user-initiated actions.

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collects web content to potentially contribute to AI model training.
user_agents.scope: Enhances the utility and safety of generative AI models by collecting training materials.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for ClaudeBot.

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Accesses websites in response to questions asked by Claude users.

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot

user_agents.opt_out: Disallow directive in robots.txt for Claude-SearchBot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot

user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under Googlebot-Image or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video

user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under Googlebot-Video or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content for Google News.

user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under Googlebot-News or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google

user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under Google-InspectionTool or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible image URLs for product teams.

user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under GoogleOther-Image or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Fetches publicly accessible video URLs for product teams.
user_agents.scope: Internal research, development, and various Google product teams.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under GoogleOther-Video or GoogleOther.

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot

user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt under Google-CloudVertexBot or Googlebot.

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes web information to improve search experience.

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Gathers and indexes web information, operating in response to user requests.

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search technology across Spotlight, Siri, Safari, and foundation model training.
user_agents.scope: General search web crawling and rendering across the web.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use robots meta tags.

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Determines usage of crawled data to train Apple generative AI foundation models.
user_agents.scope: Controls usage of content crawled by Applebot; does not crawl webpages directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot-Extended in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts.
user_agents.scope: Only registered content on Apple Podcasts; not a general search crawler.
user_agents.opt_out: Does not follow robots.txt.

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawls content shared on Meta apps like Facebook, Instagram, or Messenger.
user_agents.scope: Gathers, caches, and displays app or website information including title, description, and thumbnail.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule to robots.txt; might bypass for security or integrity checks.

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Navigates the web to improve Meta AI search result quality for users.
user_agents.scope: Analyzes online content to enhance relevance, accuracy, and cite and link to content in Meta AI.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web to improve advertising and business-related products and services.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content for advertising and other business-related products and services.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Crawls the web for training foundation AI models or improving products by indexing.
user_agents.scope: Training foundation AI models or improving products by indexing content directly.
user_agents.opt_out: Add a disallow rule for the crawler in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher
user_agents.purpose: Fetches individual links at user request and evaluates or improves agentic AI capabilities.
user_agents.scope: Helping AI navigate websites to complete tasks for users; may bypass robots.txt.
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt rules because it performs user-requested fetches.

user_agents.name: Bingbot
user_agents.purpose: Crawls web content for Bing search and Microsoft Copilot.
user_agents.scope: Web crawling for Bing search indexing and Microsoft Copilot responses.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for Bingbot in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: BingPreview
user_agents.purpose: Generates page snapshots and previews for search results.
user_agents.scope: Captures real-time snapshots of web pages for Bing previews.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow rules for BingPreview in robots.txt.

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improves products and services, and may train Amazon AI models.
user_agents.scope: Web content crawled to provide accurate information and train AI models.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use noarchive meta tag.

user_agents.name: Amzn-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Improves search experiences in Amazon products and services such as Alexa.
user_agents.scope: Website content crawled for search experiences; not used for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow in robots.txt or use noindex/none meta tags.

user_agents.name: Amzn-User
user_agents.purpose: Supports user actions and live web fetching on user's behalf.
user_agents.scope: Fetches live information for user-initiated actions; not used for generative AI training.
user_agents.opt_out: May not follow all robots.txt directives due to user initiation.

user_agents.name: CCBot
user_agents.purpose: Web crawler providing an open copy of the internet for research and analysis.
user_agents.scope: Crawls web pages using HTTP GET requests for public dataset distribution.
user_agents.opt_out: Add Disallow: / for User-agent CCBot in robots.txt or request opt-out registry addition.
